name: streamsheets

check.cmd: snap info streamsheets | grep installed > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo installed || echo uninstall

install: hash snap > /dev/null 2>&1 || sudo apt update && sudo apt install snapd -y

description.zh: Streamsheets：可以使用表格形式处理、分析流式数据。
description.en: Streamsheets is a no-code application builder. Build your apps to enable workflow automation, monitoring, and perform control in real-time.
